bio: Blending industrial design accents with soft lighting, this spot has a chic, modern ambience that's just right for bringing people together. La Condesa honors and celebrates the cuisine of Mexico with a particular focus on Mexico City. Seafood enthusiasts can expect a menu featuring the freshest ceviche or tiradito alongside an eye-catching grilled whole fish. Savor the tangy, delicious flavor of silky raw tuna atop a super crisp tortilla with aji amarillo. Sided by creamy cubes of avocado and salsa macha, it's a refreshing way to begin a meal here. Huarache de huitlacoche is a well-known dish prepared with care, and nothing completes the meal quite like cinnamon-dusted churros....
